Messages.Author: Reydax
Messages.Body:
hello ! i was just visiting
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=rulings
to spare myself from the regular tournament mistakes you can do...
and i saw this in the combat section :

The damage modifier must be played before the end of the Choose Strike
phase in order to affect the current strike. [RTR 19960112]

Can i know how this interact with, say, body arsenal ?
if this card is played à la wolf claws, it is played in a window after
the choose strike phase and before resolution of the strikes. According
to this ruling the +1 str bonus would be lost if the card is played at
this point...
so is there something i don't catch here ? :)

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <1169423239....@11g2000cwr.googlegroups.com>, Reydax

<Rey...@gmail.com> writes:
>The damage modifier must be played before the end of the Choose Strike
>phase in order to affect the current strike. [RTR 19960112]
>
>Can i know how this interact with, say, body arsenal ?
>if this card is played à la wolf claws, it is played in a window after
>the choose strike phase and before resolution of the strikes.

No, it's not. Also, if you follow the link on that RTR, Wolf Claws is
the named example of a damage modifier.

1) Start Choose Strike Phase

2) A damage modifier could be played now, if appropriate - for example,
I might want to cycle my Wolf Claws to pull a Scorpion Sting

3) Acting Methuselah chooses strike.

4) A damage modifier could be played now, if appropriate

5) Defending Methuslah chooses strike.

6) A damage modifier could be played now, if appropriate

7) End Choose Strike Phase.

8) Any damage modifiers played from now on will not affect the current
strike resolution.

The point is that you cannot play, say, Wolf Claws or Body Arsenal when
you know the opponent isn't playing Skin of Steel, or whatever, and have
it affect the current strike. But you can play it immediately after
both strikes have been chosen, but before you leave the phase..

--
